recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示伸出的舌頭表面光滑、泛紅且有明顯溝裂，舌乳頭變平（萎縮性舌炎 atrophic glossitis），為缺鐵的非血液學表現之一；本張照片看不到匙狀指甲或口角炎。
features: Clinical photograph of a protruded tongue
Smooth, glossy, erythematous (beefy) dorsal surface with loss of filiform papillae
Prominent fissures and furrows on the dorsum
Angular cheilitis and koilonychia are not visible in this photograph
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a protruded tongue with a smooth, shiny, erythematous surface and apparent loss of papillae, accompanied by deep fissures. The oral commissures are not well demonstrated, and no angular cheilitis is evident; the nails are not shown. Findings are consistent with atrophic glossitis, a recognized epithelial manifestation of iron deficiency, although the appearance is not specific.

ddx.dx: Vitamin B12 or folate deficiency glossitis (Hunter glossitis)
ddx.vs: Appearance is clinically indistinguishable, so serum B12/folate levels and red cell indices (macrocytosis) are needed.
Shows migrating, well-demarcated red patches with white serpiginous borders rather than diffuse papillary atrophy.
Fissures occur with preserved papillae and normal color, without diffuse smooth atrophy.
